remarks: Located in fantastic well desired gated community. This corner Townhouse has just been painted throughout and has new carpets that have a 15-year warranty. The Unit is a sound investment for someone with vision and looking for value or looking to simply move in. This Chesterfield Complex has gated 24 hr. security, is pet friendly, has a clubhouse, & two pools. Parking spots are available right in front of this corner townhouse. The Unit has vaulted ceilings, is very bright with sun filled skylights in the living room, stairwell and bathroom. The focal point of the main level is a huge living room with fireplace and sliding doors connected to a large deck, a separate Dining Room (which could be used as a Home office), EIK with ceiling fan and a half bath. The 2nd level has a large bedroom, with ceiling fan, large closets, & an ensuite bathroom with a private toilet. The Chesterfield complex has a proven upside, and has potential for an immediate increase in value.
